selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why did the traveler want to enter the human world at this point in his journey?
questions.answer: He wanted to move higher through the many levels of knowing Allah.

questions.question: What group especially represents humanity here?
questions.answer: The prophets especially represent humanity.

questions.question: When he looked at earlier times, what united action did he observe among the prophets?
questions.answer: He saw them all together declaring the oneness of Allah and remembering Him.

questions.question: What did the traveler do in the prophets’ school?
questions.answer: He humbled himself, listened carefully, and learned from them.

questions.question: What had Allah given each prophet to confirm his duty?
questions.answer: Allah had given each prophet many signs in the form of miracles.

questions.question: What kind of people are those followers described as?
questions.answer: They are described as serious and truthful people.

questions.question: How are the believers described in contrast to those who reject?
questions.answer: They are described as the most truthful and righteous people.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ personal qualities function as evidence?
questions.answer: Their moral excellence, sincerity, strong faith, and sacrifice show that they were honest and trustworthy.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ strong faith and sacrifice add to the proof?
questions.answer: They show sincerity and honesty, proving they truly believed what they taught.

questions.question: What benefit did he receive from the prophets’ lessons?
questions.answer: He gained a strong increase in faith.

questions.question: In this passage, what new area does the meditating traveler enter?
questions.answer: He enters the world of human beings.

questions.question: Into what realm did he choose to go next?
questions.answer: He chose to go into the realm of mankind.

questions.question: What made the prophets’ proclamation more than just words?
questions.answer: Their message was backed by many miracles that clearly supported them.

questions.question: What educational image is used for the prophets in the passage?
questions.answer: They are shown like teachers in a school of light.

questions.question: How is the traveler described as receiving this lesson?
questions.answer: He receives it with humility, attention, and willingness to learn.

questions.question: Why is widespread agreement among truthful witnesses important here?
questions.answer: Because united testimony from many honest people strongly supports the certainty of the claim.

questions.question: What does the passage say becomes clearer to the traveler when he sees believers accept the truth?
questions.answer: He sees more clearly the holiness and value of faith.

questions.question: How does the passage contrast believers with deniers?
questions.answer: Believers are presented as truthful and righteous, while deniers are shown as deeply mistaken.

questions.question: What does the harmony among prophets and their followers reveal?
questions.answer: It reveals a strong unity, mutual support, and consistency in the truth they carry.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveler draw from the place of prophets within the pillars of faith?
questions.answer: He concludes that belief in all prophets gives faith extra strength and support.

questions.question: What was the traveler hoping to gain by going farther on his journey?
questions.answer: He wanted deeper knowledge of Allah through ever higher spiritual stages.

questions.question: What did he first see when he looked toward the people of the past?
questions.answer: He saw all the prophets united in declaring Allah’s oneness and remembering Him.

questions.question: What gave force to the prophets’ call?
questions.answer: Their many miracles gave force to their call.

questions.question: What does the passage say the prophets were teaching people to become?
questions.answer: They were teaching them to rise to a higher, noble, almost angel-like rank.
